title: AclRunFacet
description: The `duckdb_acl` run facet - duckdb-acl via acl-otel (spec 018): who ran a statement on an ACL node, as far as the node's operator lets it say, and how exact the run's lineage is.

client.description: the door the statement came through: flight, quack, session or gateway (admin / operator for the node's own statements)

issuer.description: the identity provider that verified the principal

subject.description: the token's sub - only when the node's acl_lineage_identity is 'subject'

approximate.description: some edges could not be derived exactly (a table function, a source that does not bind)

truncated.description: edges were cut at the node's acl_lineage_max_edges
